scope: Q11-Q14 only; Q10-E001 and Q10-A001 have separate owners
fit_definition: One neural fit trains one network on one source-only partition for one seed. One shallow fit trains one complete source-only feature/classifier pipeline. Frozen Q8/Q9 comparator fits are reused and are not counted as new fits.

primary_contract.outer: nine LOSO folds, both target sessions held out
primary_contract.inner: four consecutive pairs among the sorted eight outer-source subjects
primary_contract.selection: earliest epoch minimizing equal-inner-fold mean of within-fold validation-cross-entropy ranks over epochs 1..40
primary_contract.target_data_policy: No target labels or target-cohort statistics for fitting, selection, normalization, alignment, stopping, weighting, or condition choice. Per-trial deterministic input features are permitted.
primary_contract.preprocessing: Unless a condition explicitly changes representation, retain Q8/Q9 22 EEG channels, 250 Hz, trial-start [2.5,5.5) seconds, all target trials, Q8 run-local filtering, and fixed microvolt conversion.

external_contract_candidate_not_frozen.excluded_runs: All execution, rest, and bilateral hands/feet runs
external_contract_candidate_not_frozen.physio_outer_source_inner_rule_candidate: For each held-out target, sort all eligible other subject IDs and assign consecutive balanced chunks to four validation groups, with sizes differing by at most one; refit every transform within each group split.
external_contract_candidate_not_frozen.selection_rule_candidate: earliest epoch minimizing equal-inner-fold mean within-fold validation-CE rank over epochs 1..40; three fixed final seeds

analysis_plan.primary_unit: held_out_subject; average three paired final seeds within each subject before the equal-subject mean
analysis_plan.bnci_primary_contrast_status: exploratory_post_Q9; no new BNCI comparison is independent confirmation
analysis_plan.external_primary_contrast_candidate: Q14-E003 PHYSIO_LOSO_MU_BETA_SHARED minus PHYSIO_LOSO_BROAD_EEGNET, paired subject-level balanced accuracy; lock before any PhysioNet performance is inspected
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Subject-resampling bootstrap CI with seed nested inside subject; report all individual effects. Exact nine-subject sign-flip is an exploratory sensitivity because outer training sets overlap.
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Declare contrast families before inference and report unadjusted plus within-family Holm-adjusted p-values if inferential p-values are used; do not treat trials, seeds, or source subsets as independent subjects.
analysis_plan.source_count_aggregation: Average the four deterministic subsets within each held-out subject and source-count k before subject-level analysis; frozen k=8 comparator is reused.
analysis_plan.negative_results: Retain every technical failure, null effect, worsened subject, and zero-recall class; no target-driven stop or seed/condition selection.

gates.requirement: Recompute Q9 trial identities, probabilities, metrics, selection, fit boundaries, and checkpoint hashes independently; orchestration-only batch validation is insufficient.

Freeze exactly two deep methods, one shallow method, comparison direction, binary label mapping, common electrodes, sampling and reference before PhysioNet performance is inspected.

experiments.subset_rule: For each outer target, sort its eight source IDs; for each k in 2,4,6 take the cyclic windows of length k starting at indices 0,2,4,6. Thus each source is represented equally often at a given k. Use the original source-only selected epoch for that model and outer target, frozen from all eight sources; do not reselect by target or subset target performance.

experiments.hypothesis: Training on one source session may reveal session-mix dependence hidden by the primary two-session source pool.
experiments.selection_note: Use each method's frozen all-source selected epoch per target; target inference is always reported separately for both sessions. Existing target-session stratification requires zero new fits.

experiments.hypothesis: A common binary left/right imagery protocol can be defined without inspecting external target classification performance.
Re-trained BNCI binary baselines establish the task-, channel-, and window-matched source reference for external validation.
A model trained and selected exclusively on BNCI binary source data can be evaluated zero-shot on PhysioNet people without any PhysioNet fitting.
Within-PhysioNet LOSO provides an independent-cohort binary method comparison and distinguishes cohort shift from zero-shot cross-dataset shift.
experiments.fit_formula: two deep methods times N target subjects times (four source-only inner fits plus three final seed fits); one shallow source fit per target subject
